apps.localizedDescription: Share a Google Maps pin, get an Uber deep link to that exact spot plus 10 probe links on a 100 m circle to compare fares and detect zone boundaries. Real proof: $9.32 vs $11.37 for the same ride in Condado, San Juan — 22% saved with a one-minute walk. Free, no ads, no tracking.
apps.name: Maps2Uber
apps.subtitle: Google Maps pin → Uber deep links + 10 fare probes
